subject: Billing discrepancy on June invoice
message: Hi, I was charged $149.99 on my June invoice but my plan is supposed to be $99.99/month. I haven't made any changes to my subscription. Can you please look into this and issue a refund for the difference?

subject: Cannot access my account after password reset
message: I reset my password yesterday but now I keep getting 'invalid credentials' when I try to log in. I've tried resetting again but the email never arrives. My account email is carlos.m@email.com. This is urgent as I need to download my tax documents before the deadline.

subject: Question about upgrading plan
message: Customer called asking about the differences between the Professional and Enterprise plans. Specifically interested in API rate limits, number of user seats, and whether data migration is included in the upgrade. Currently on Professional plan for 8 months.

subject: Application crashes when exporting reports
message: Every time I try to export a report to PDF from the dashboard, the application freezes and then crashes. This started happening after the update last week. I'm using Chrome 125 on Windows 11. I've cleared cache and tried incognito mode but the issue persists. This is blocking my weekly reporting to management.

subject: Feedback on new mobile app
message: Just wanted to share some positive feedback — the new mobile app update is fantastic! The navigation is much smoother and the dark mode looks great. One small suggestion: it would be nice to have a widget for the home screen showing my usage stats. Keep up the good work!
